dish: 12-topping kaisen-don at the Curb Market's oldest canteen
n: Kaisen Shokudō Kita no Gourmet-tei, Curb Market (海鮮食堂 北のグルメ亭)
address: Sapporo Central Wholesale Market — Jōgai Shijō, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: The Curb Market's longest-running big canteen-cum-shop — its signature bowl lays twelve oversized toppings over rice.

dish: seasonal kaisen-don from a crab wholesaler's kitchen
address: Sapporo Central Wholesale Market — Jōgai Shijō, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: Run by crab-and-seafood wholesaler Marusan Mikami Shōten — about eight seasonal toppings (tuna, uni, scallop, salmon) heaped on one bowl.

n: Kaisen-dokoro Uoya no Daidokoro, Nijō Market (海鮮処 魚屋の台所)
address: Nijō Market, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
w: A Nijō Market bowl shop opened by a long-time sushi chef to sell the freshest fish at fair prices — No. 2 in a MAPPLE readers' seafood ranking.

dish: Biei vegetables — JA market, Biei-wheat bread and the French restaurant Asperges
w: JA Biei's food hall of morning-picked vegetables and limited Biei-wheat bread, with the French restaurant Asperges cooking the town's produce next door.
